mentions.name: Plates
mentions.description: A weightlifting workout tracking and analytics app for iOS. It is a native iOS app sold as a one-time purchase that emphasizes privacy: workout data is saved locally without depending on a backend, while still syncing to the cloud.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been hard at work building a weightlifting workout tracking & analytics app. Its main selling points are being iOS native, being a one-time purchase, and being completely private (does not depend on a backend, but still saves data to the cloud).
